title: Thai Maaman
desc: Meena refuses to marry Rasappan as he is uneducated and rustic. In order to win her heart, he decides to become a minister and achieve success.

title: Yeidhavan
desc: When Krishna's sister is killed during a college protest, he vows to avenge her. However, he ends up helping the medical students to gain their rights.

title: Bharathan
desc: Upon being falsely incriminated for his older brother's murder, Bharath plots revenge against a powerful businessman with the help of three convicts.

title: Makkal Aatchi
desc: Sethupathi, a common man, gets lucky when he accidentally finds a large amount of money in a truck. He decides to use the money to enter politics and ends up becoming the chief minister of the state.

title: Dharma Chakkaram
desc: Chakkaravarthy loses a challenge with Arumugam, which leads to his girlfriend sacrificing her life. Years later, Chakkaravarthy meets another woman who shares her name with his former lover.
